semiconductor_relevance: High — Infinity Vision Technology Corp. Ltd specializes in advanced non-destructive X-ray inspection solutions specifically for semiconductor applications.
summary: Infinity Vision Technology Corp. Ltd is a Taiwan-based company that provides advanced non-destructive X-ray inspection technologies for semiconductor manufacturing, PCB, and advanced packaging. Their solutions focus on high-accuracy quality assurance through 2D, 2.5D, and 3D X-ray inspection, enabling efficient defect detection and process monitoring.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Infinity Vision is based in Taiwan, focusing on the semiconductor and electronics manufacturing sectors.
